A faithful recreation of the **Claude Code** look — warm paper and charcoal surfaces, the signature coral accent, and a calm reading rhythm. Links glow [like this](https://obsidian.md), inline code sits in `soft pills`, and ==highlights== stay warm.

## Code, the heart of it

```ts
export const theme = {
  accent: "#d97757",   // Claude coral
  surfaces: ["warm cream", "warm charcoal"],
  mood: "calm",
};
```

> [!tip] Serif reading mode
> One toggle swaps body text to a Tiempos-style serif — headings and the interface stay sans.
